definition_en: a firm hold, control over something, or a small clip for hair
core_image: 一只手紧紧握住冰冷的栏杆
scene: 她紧紧握住栏杆。She held the rail with a firm grip.
sceneCN: 这里 grip 是「紧握」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她紧紧握住栏杆。

senses.title: Firm hold
senses.definition: a strong hold with the hand
senses.definitionCN: 用手牢牢抓住
senses.example: She held the rail with a firm grip.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Control or understanding
senses.definition: power over something or a clear understanding of it
senses.definitionCN: 对某事的控制力或清晰理解
senses.example: The coach has a good grip on the team.
senses.exampleCN: 教练对球队掌控得很好。
senses.why: Holding became controlling in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 手中的「握住」延伸为心智上的「掌握」。

senses.title: Small clip
senses.definition: a small piece of metal or plastic that holds hair
senses.definitionCN: 夹住头发的小金属或塑料夹
senses.example: She fixed her hair with a grip.
senses.why: The clip grips the hair, just as a hand grips.
senses.whyCN: 发夹「夹住」头发，正如手「握住」物体。

intro.en: Grip comes from Old English grippan, to seize, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: grip 来自古英语 grippan（抓住），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant to seize or grasp.
Grippan meant to seize with the hand.
Grippen kept the sense of a firm hold.
items.cn: grippen 保留了牢牢抓住的含义。

items.en: The noun named the hold itself.
The sense of mental control grew later.

note.en: Grip is compared with look-alike words and words for holding.
note.cn: 把 grip 与形近词以及表示握持的词作比较。

entries.definition: to keep something in your hand

normalIntro.en: Grip is the hand closing on something, and later the mind closing on an idea.

normal.en: He lost his grip and fell.
The story has a gripping plot.
normal.cn: 这个故事情节扣人心弦。

normal.en: The town is in the grip of winter.

abstract.en: What the hand holds, the mind can master.
abstract.cn: 手能握住的，心也能掌握。

abstract.en: A loose grip loses the rope.
abstract.cn: 手一松，绳子就滑走了。

abstract.en: Fear grips before it explains.
abstract.cn: 恐惧先抓住人，再去解释。

examples.en: She held the rail with a firm grip.
The coach has a good grip on the team.
examples.cn: 教练对球队掌控得很好。

examples.en: She fixed her hair with a grip.

dict_mnemonic.text: grip 是「紧握、掌控」，也指「发夹」；get a grip 是控制住自己，in the grip of 是受……控制；过去式双写 p 变 gripped。

root: 来自古英语 grippan（抓住），源于日耳曼语词根；由手上的「握住」引申为对事物的掌控与理解。

sensesIntro.en: Grip means a firm hold, control or understanding, or a hair clip.

core.en: The hand closing hard around something.

branches.en: Fingers lock around a cold rail.

branches.en: A small clip holds a strand of hair.
branches.cn: 一枚小夹子夹住一缕头发。

intro.en: Grip forms verb parts, agent nouns, and adjectives.
intro.cn: grip 构成动词变化、施动名词和形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

definition_en: a person who sells food and small household goods
core_image: 街角小店的主人把纸袋递给顾客
scene: 街角的杂货商认得每位邻居。The grocer on the corner knows every neighbour.

senses.title: Food shopkeeper

intro.en: Grocer comes from Old French grossier, a wholesaler, from Latin grossus, large or coarse.

core.en: A person who keeps and sells everyday food.

branches.en: A shopkeeper weighs out sugar.

branches.en: Shopkeeper and shop share one name.

branches.en: Retail grew out of wholesale trade.

intro.en: Grocer forms plurals and a family of food-shop words.
intro.cn: grocer 构成复数以及一组与食品店相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is grossus, large or coarse.

normal.en: Put the grocery bag on the table.

abstract.en: Small goods hold a whole trade.

core_image: 账本最后一页写着未扣除的总数
scene: 公司公布年度总收入。The company reported its gross income for the year.

senses.title: Total before deductions
senses.definition: total, before costs or tax are taken away

senses.why: This is the main business sense.

senses.title: Very serious

normalIntro.en: Gross began as thick or coarse and now means total, serious, or disgusting.

definition_en: a number of people or things together, or to put them together

scene: 一群学生站在门口。A group of students stood at the door.

senses.title: Set of people or things
senses.definition: several people or things that are together
senses.definitionCN: 聚在一起的一些人或物
senses.example: A group of students stood at the door.
senses.why: This is the basic collective sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的集合义项。

senses.title: Organization
senses.definition: an organized set of people with a shared aim
senses.definitionCN: 有共同目标、组织起来的一群人

senses.why: A crowd with a purpose becomes an organization.

senses.title: Put together

senses.definitionCN: 把人或物分成若干组

note.en: Group is compared with look-alike words and words for sets of people.

examples.en: A group of students stood at the door.

definition_en: to become larger, to plant and raise crops, or to change into a state
core_image: 番茄苗在阳光下一点点长高
scene: 番茄在阳光下生长。The tomatoes grow in the sun.
sceneCN: 这里 grow 是「生长」（第 1 个义项）；句意：番茄在阳光下生长。

senses.title: Become larger
senses.definition: to become larger or taller over time
senses.definitionCN: 随时间变大或长高
senses.example: The tomatoes grow in the sun.
senses.why: This is the basic biological sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的生物义项。

senses.title: Raise plants
senses.definition: to plant and care for crops or plants
senses.definitionCN: 栽种并照料庄稼或植物
senses.example: They grow rice in the valley.
senses.why: People make plants grow on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 人有意让植物生长，就是种植。

senses.title: Become a state
senses.definition: to change gradually into a state or condition
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐进入某种状态
senses.example: The sky grew dark.
senses.why: Growth became change of any kind.
senses.whyCN: 「生长」扩展为任何逐渐的变化。

intro.en: Grow comes from Old English growan, to grow, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: grow 来自古英语 growan（生长），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant to grow or increase.
Growan meant to grow like a plant.
items.cn: growan 指像植物一样生长。

items.en: Grow kept the plant sense and gained increase.
items.cn: grow 保留植物义，并获得「增加」义。

items.en: The sense of becoming a state appeared.
items.cn: 「逐渐变成某种状态」的用法出现。

items.en: Growing crops became a common use.

note.en: Grow is compared with look-alike words and words for increase.
note.cn: 把 grow 与形近词以及表示增长的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grow is to get bigger, to make plants bigger, or to become something new.
normalIntro.cn: grow 是变大、把植物种大，或渐渐变成另一种状态。

normal.en: She grew up in a small town.

normal.cn: 这座城市每年都在扩张。

abstract.en: What is planted slowly becomes a tree.
abstract.cn: 种下的东西，会慢慢长成树。

abstract.en: Time makes both children and ideas grow.
abstract.cn: 时间让孩子与想法一同成长。

abstract.en: To grow is to accept becoming other.
abstract.cn: 成长，就是接受自己变成另一种样子。

examples.en: The tomatoes grow in the sun.
They grow rice in the valley.
The sky grew dark.

dict_mnemonic.text: grow 是「生长、种植、变得」；grow up 是长大，grow into 是长成，grow crops 是种庄稼；过去式 grew，过去分词 grown。

root: 来自古英语 growan（生长），源于日耳曼语词根；由植物生长扩展到数量增加、种植，以及逐渐变成某种状态。

sensesIntro.en: Grow means to become larger, to raise plants, or to change gradually into a state.
sensesIntro.cn: grow 指变大、种植植物，或逐渐变成某种状态。

core.en: Living things adding size over time.
core.cn: 活物随时间不断增加体积。

branches.en: A shoot lifts toward the light.
branches.cn: 嫩芽朝着光长高。

branches.en: Hands press seeds into soil.
branches.cn: 双手把种子按进土里。

branches.en: The evening sky turns grey.
branches.cn: 傍晚的天空转灰。

branches.en: Nature grows and people help it grow.
branches.cn: 自然让植物生长，人帮它生长。

branches.en: Size and state both change with time.
branches.cn: 体积与状态，都随时间改变。

intro.en: Grow forms irregular verb parts and several nouns.
intro.cn: grow 构成不规则动词变化和若干名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.

items.exampleCN: 本地种植者在这里出售。

definition_en: the process of becoming larger, an increase, or an abnormal lump in the body
core_image: 小树苗一年年长高成树
scene: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
sceneCN: 这里 growth 是「生长」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小树苗的生长需要阳光。

senses.title: Biological growth
senses.definition: the process by which a living thing becomes larger
senses.definitionCN: 生物变大的过程
senses.example: The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。
senses.why: This is the basic living sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的生命义项。

senses.title: Increase
senses.definition: an increase in size, number, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 规模、数量或金额的增加
senses.example: Economic growth slowed last year.
senses.why: The living sense spread to numbers and trade.
senses.whyCN: 生命义扩展到数字与贸易。

senses.title: Abnormal lump
senses.definition: an unusual lump growing in or on the body
senses.definitionCN: 身体内外异常长出的肿块
senses.example: The doctor removed a small growth.
senses.exampleCN: 医生切除了一个小肿块。
senses.why: A growth is simply something that grows.

intro.en: Growth is grow plus the Old English noun ending -th, as in warmth and length.

items.en: The root meant to grow or increase.

items.cn: 后缀 -th 构成表示状态的名词。

items.en: Growthe named the process of growing.
The sense widened to economic increase.

note.en: Growth is compared with look-alike words and words for increase.

branches.en: A young tree widens its trunk.
branches.cn: 小树加粗了自己的树干。

branches.en: A small lump appears under the skin.
branches.cn: 皮下出现一个小肿块。

branches.en: Living things and markets both rise.

definition_en: a firm promise that something will be done, or a promise to repair or replace goods
core_image: 店家在收据上写下一年保修的承诺
scene: 店家保证一年内免费维修。The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
sceneCN: 这里 guarantee 是「保证」（第 1 个义项）；句意：店家保证一年内免费维修。

senses.title: Firm promise
senses.definition: a formal promise that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 对某事必定发生的正式承诺
senses.example: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 店家保证一年内免费维修。
senses.why: This is the general modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最通用的义项。

senses.title: Product warranty
senses.definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product
senses.definitionCN: 对产品修理或更换的书面承诺
senses.example: The phone is still under guarantee.
senses.exampleCN: 这部手机还在保修期内。
senses.why: Shops turned the promise into a document.
senses.whyCN: 商家把承诺变成了一纸凭证。

senses.title: Legal surety
senses.definition: a promise to pay another person's debt if they fail
senses.definitionCN: 在他人无法偿还时替其付款的承诺
senses.example: His uncle guaranteed the loan.
senses.exampleCN: 他的叔叔为这笔贷款作了担保。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a pledge for another.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是为他人作保。

intro.en: Guarantee comes from Old French garantie, a pledge of protection, from garantir, to protect.

items.en: The root meant to protect or guard.
Garant meant a person who protects.
Garantie meant a pledge.
Guarantee meant a promise of safety.

note.en: Guarantee is compared with look-alike words and words for promises.

normalIntro.en: Guarantee began as protection and now means a firm promise or a warranty.

abstract.en: A warranty is trust written down.

examples.en: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.

sensesIntro.en: Guarantee means a firm promise, a product warranty, or legal surety for another.

core.en: A promise that stands behind something.

branches.en: A seller gives a firm word.

branches.en: A relative signs for a loan.

branches.en: The spoken promise becomes a paper right.

scene: 陪审团裁定他有罪。The jury found him guilty.
sceneCN: 这里 guilty 是「有罪的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：陪审团裁定他有罪。

senses.title: Legally responsible
senses.definition: having been proved to have committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 被证明犯了罪的
senses.example: The jury found him guilty.
senses.why: This is the legal sense that leads the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最主要的法律义项。

senses.title: Feeling shame
senses.definition: feeling bad because you have done something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因做错事而心里难受
senses.example: She felt guilty about the lie.
senses.exampleCN: 她为那个谎言感到内疚。
senses.why: The court sense moved inward to feeling.
senses.whyCN: 法庭上的「有罪」转向内心的感受。

senses.title: Responsible for a fault
senses.definition: having caused a mistake or bad result
senses.definitionCN: 造成错误或不良后果的
senses.example: He was guilty of carelessness.
senses.why: Not every fault is a crime, yet blame remains.
senses.whyCN: 并非每个过失都是犯罪，但仍需担责。

intro.en: Guilty is guilt plus -y; guilt comes from Old English gylt, a crime or fault.
intro.cn: guilty 由 guilt 加 -y 构成；guilt 来自古英语 gylt，意为罪过。

items.en: The root meant a debt or a fault.
items.cn: 该词根意为欠债或过失。

items.en: Gylt meant a crime or sin.
Guilt named the state of having done wrong.
Guilty described a person in law.
items.cn: guilty 指法律上有罪的人。

items.en: The feeling sense grew strong in daily use.
items.cn: 日常使用中「内疚」义逐渐增强。

note.en: Guilty is compared with look-alike words and words for blame.
note.cn: 把 guilty 与形近词以及表示罪责的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Guilty starts in court and ends in the heart: a verdict, a fault, or a bad feeling.
normalIntro.cn: guilty 从法庭走进内心：裁决、过失，或难受的感觉。

abstract.en: A verdict names a fact; guilt names a weight.
abstract.cn: 裁决说出事实，内疚说出重量。

abstract.en: No court is needed for a quiet conscience.
abstract.cn: 良心的审判，不需要法庭。

abstract.en: Blame can be shared, but guilt is felt alone.
abstract.cn: 责任可以分担，内疚只能独自承受。

examples.en: The jury found him guilty.
She felt guilty about the lie.
examples.cn: 她为那个谎言感到内疚。

examples.en: He was guilty of carelessness.

dict_mnemonic.text: guilty 是「有罪的、内疚的」；feel guilty 是感到内疚，guilty of 是犯有……罪，not guilty 是无罪；名词是 guilt，副词是 guiltily。

root: 由 guilt 加形容词后缀 -y 构成，guilt 来自古英语 gylt（罪过）；由法律上的「有罪」扩展为内心的「内疚」和一般「有过失」。

sensesIntro.en: Guilty means legally responsible, feeling shame, or responsible for a fault.

core.en: Having done wrong, in law or in the heart.

branches.en: A judge reads a solemn verdict.

branches.cn: 说谎的人把目光移开。

branches.en: A report names a careless mistake.
branches.cn: 报告指出一处粗心的过失。

branches.en: The courtroom verdict echoes inside.

branches.en: Small faults can leave a large weight.

senses.title: Stringed instrument
